protocol.point: central path (every shock at its median)

comparator_labels.carry_forward: No change: the last observed value carried forward
comparator_labels.recent_average: Recent average: the mean of the last few periods carried forward
comparator_labels.linear_trend: Linear trend: a straight line fitted to every period before the cutoff, extended
comparator_labels.holt_damped: Damped trend: exponential smoothing with a damped trend (ETS)
comparator_labels.bass_diffusion: Bass diffusion: the standard adoption curve fitted to every period before the cutoff

mae.label: Error in questions posted per 13 weeks
